text: SQL. Writing and reasoning about SQL queries against relational databases.
SQL SELECT & Filtering. Basic SELECT statements, WHERE clauses, and filtering rows.
SQL Joins. Combining rows from multiple tables with INNER/LEFT/RIGHT/FULL joins.
SQL Aggregation & HAVING. GROUP BY, aggregate functions, and filtering aggregated results.
SQL Window Functions. Ranking, running totals, and partitioned analytics with window functions.
SQL CTEs. Structuring complex queries with common table expressions.
SQL Query Optimization. Reading execution plans and tuning slow queries over large datasets.
Python. General-purpose Python programming for data and analysis tasks.
Python Data Manipulation. Cleaning, reshaping, and joining datasets with pandas.
Python Statistical Computing. Applying statistical methods and modelling in Python (NumPy/SciPy/statsmodels).
Statistics. Applying statistical analysis techniques to real datasets.
Descriptive Statistics. Summarizing data with measures of central tendency and dispersion.
Inferential Statistics. Hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, and generalizing from samples.
Survey Methodology. Sampling design, weighting, and variance estimation for complex surveys.
Regression Analysis. Linear and logistic regression modelling and interpretation.
Data Visualization. Communicating data findings through effective visual design.
Dashboard Design. Building interactive dashboards for non-technical stakeholders.
Statistical Charting. Choosing and building the right chart type for a statistical claim.
Machine Learning. Applying machine learning techniques to structured data problems.
Supervised Learning. Training and validating classification/regression models.
Model Evaluation. Choosing metrics and diagnosing over/underfitting.
Geographic Information Systems. Working with geospatial data and GIS software.
Spatial Data Analysis. Analysing spatial patterns and relationships in geographic data.
GIS Software Tools. Practical use of GIS software for mapping and analysis.
Database Management. Designing and operating relational database management systems.
Relational Database Design. Schema design, normalization, and indexing strategy.
Database Administration. Operating, securing, and maintaining a production database.
Data Engineering. Building pipelines that move and transform data reliably.
ETL Pipelines. Extracting, transforming, and loading data between systems.
Data Quality & Cleaning. Detecting and correcting data quality issues before analysis.
Survey Sampling Design. Designing probability samples for official statistics collection.
Statistical Report Writing. Writing clear, accurate statistical reports for policy audiences.
Data Governance & Ethics. Applying data privacy, security, and governance standards to official data.
Stakeholder Communication. Explaining technical findings to non-technical decision-makers.
Senior Statistical Officer. Leads official statistics production: survey design, estimation, and reporting for government data programmes.
Senior Data Analyst. Turns raw administrative and survey data into decision-ready analysis and dashboards.
Lead Data Scientist. Builds predictive models and advanced analytics on top of official statistics datasets.
Statistical Programmer. Implements and optimizes the data pipelines and queries behind official statistics products.
GIS Analyst. Produces spatial statistics and mapping products from geographic and survey data.
Data Engineer. Builds and maintains the data pipelines and databases that feed the statistical office's systems.
